text: UMass Boston 8, Plymouth State 5. Two clocks tell this story.
Three Beacons already on the crease.
Same pair, roles swapped. Krivtsov takes it to the net.
Merryman. Then Repmann. 4–1 after the first.
Then it turned. Plymouth State scores twice in 15 seconds. 4–4.
Two minutes later, three on two. Krivtsov again.
One more power play. Thirteen seconds left in the second.
Five on four. Drummond low, Kurtas up top.
Kurtas, up top, finds Mortson at the far circle.
One-timer, on one knee. And Krivtsov is right in the goalie's eyes.
From above: Mortson 34 feet out. Krivtsov screening in the slot.
10 seconds in. 7.7 left. 8 goals on 38 shots.
And, the team says, the head coach's 500th game.
